description: List Foundations counselors, optionally filtered by service (use list_services for ids), office, Spanish-language counseling, online sessions, or the client's age. For a child or teen, pass their age: each counselor's published ages differ (for example 4+, 12+, 3-12 and 18+), and the child-teen-therapy tag alone does not mean a counselor sees young children. Results come back in a neutral, rotating order and are never ranked by fit: Foundations matches each client with a counselor first, and the free consultation is with that matched counselor. Availability is not published per counselor, so these results say nothing about openings.

age.description: The client's age in years. Returns only counselors whose published Populations Served includes that age. Used for filtering only; never logged or stored.

office.description: Office id; "fort-collins" covers both Fort Collins offices.

online.description: Only counselors whose profiles list online counseling.

service.description: Service id from list_services, e.g. anxiety-therapy, couples-therapy, child-teen-therapy.

spanish.description: Only counselors whose profiles list Spanish-language or bilingual counseling.

name: find_counselors
title: Find counselors
